purpose: Teach: 文体/電動/見送り/例文/厚み/大きめ/学費/利上げ

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 昔の文書、文体、堅かった。
lines.en: The old documents — the writing style was stiff.
lines.style: Patient, measured observation. Slight pause before the clarification. Quiet authority of someone reflecting on decades of pattern. Unhurried breath.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。電動化、業界全体で進んでいます。
lines.en: Yes. Electrification is moving across the entire industry.
lines.style: Respectful acknowledgment. Clear, steady pacing. Slight lean-in — showing he's listened carefully and is meeting the thought seriously. Professional but not stiff.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 重要な見送り、若い頃にも経験した。
lines.en: Important transitions like that — I experienced them when I was younger too.
lines.style: Gentle, knowing tone. Slight weight on the memory. Speaking not as lecture but as someone who lived through similar crossroads. Warm nostalgia without sentimentality.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。例文集、若手の教科書として残しています。
lines.en: Yes. We keep that example collection as a textbook for younger staff.
lines.style: Steady, deliberate delivery. Pride in the system without boasting. Each phrase carries intention — showing this isn't accidental but designed.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 契約書、厚みが出る案件、扱い、慎重に。
lines.en: Contracts that get thicker — complex deals like that require careful handling.
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. Speaking from experience without condescension. Slight emphasis on 'careful' — not a warning, a principle. Quiet conviction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。社員一律、大きめの福利、提供してます。
lines.en: Yes. We offer enhanced benefits across all staff uniformly.
lines.style: Direct and clear. Matter-of-fact delivery that lets the policy speak for itself. No defensiveness, just stating what is. Respectful, unadorned.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 学費支援、若い頃の私も、頂いた。
lines.en: Tuition support — I received that myself when I was young.
lines.style: Quiet, personal. The memory sits close to the surface. Speaking as testimony, not as abstract principle. Slight trailing breath at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: はい。利上げ局面、長期戦略で乗り切ります。
lines.en: Yes. In a rising rate environment, we'll navigate it with a long-term strategy.
lines.style: Composed closing. Confident but not cavalier. Each word placed carefully. The settling tone of someone who has seen cycles and trusts the approach. Calm resolve.
